en.title: Merge Two Password Strings Alternately
en.description:
Take the first character of a, the first character of b, the second character of a, the second character of b, and so on; once one string is used up, append the rest of the other string.

The standard input/output format and examples were compiled by this site; ranges explicitly marked as this site's are not the source's original constraints.
en.input: Two lines containing a and b respectively. The source has no numeric bounds; on this site each string has 0 to 100000 printable ASCII characters (spaces allowed, but no newlines).
en.output: Output the merged string as one whole line, preserving spaces.
en.explanation: The correct outputs are hmaocuknetrariannk; abc; and aXbYZ. A spelling error in the original site's first example has been corrected.
hints: Iterate over indices up to the longer length, checking and appending the corresponding characters of the two strings in turn.
